newsitem.title: USA: Vallicorp in merger with Auburn Bancorp.
newsitem.headline: Vallicorp in merger with Auburn Bancorp.

text.p: ValliCorp Holdings Inc said Monday that shareholders of Auburn Bancorp voted to approve the merger with Vallicorp.
Auburn has assets of some $75 million with three branches located in Sacramento, Placer and Nevada Counties.

Auburn shareholders will receive 0.8209 shares of Vallicorp common stock for each share of Auburn common stock. The deal is structured as a tax-free exchange and is planned to be accounted for using the purchase method.
The merger, pending regulatory approvals, is set to close on September 13.
The merger boosts Vallicorp's assets to some $1.4 billion. Shares of Vallicorp were 3/4 higher at 18-7/8 in morning trading on Nasdaq.
